primary_sources.title: Allen Hatcher, Notes on Basic 3-Manifold Topology
primary_sources.used_statement: Chapter1 compressible tori and irreducibility; boundary incompressibility of orientable Seifert manifolds other than solid tori; Chapter3 loop theorem.

primary_sources.title: Walter Neumann and Paul Norbury, The Orevkov invariant of an affine plane curve
primary_sources.used_statement: Section4, pp5-6: a one-place-at-infinity polynomial curve has a finite iterated-torus cabling description. No positivity assumption is added.

primary_sources.title: Tetsuya Ito, A Note on Chirally Cosmetic Surgery on Cable Knots, Canad.Math.Bull.64(2021),163-173
primary_sources.used_statement: Section2 and section-regular-fiber bases: cable space is Seifert over annulus with one exceptional fiber; inner fiber pq*meridian+longitude and outer peripheral bases. Our p denotes winding, whereas Ito uses q. No cosmetic-surgery theorem is imported.

primary_sources.title: Grisha Perelman, Finite extinction time for the solutions to the Ricci flow on certain three-manifolds (2003)
primary_sources.used_statement: Section1.4: elliptization, closed oriented finite-fundamental-group three-manifolds are spherical space forms. Applied only to the stable end group C3 to recognize a lens space; cyclic spherical space forms are lens spaces.
